description.value:
Duration constant

When you roll on the Slip table, roll twice and choose which result applies. This does not stack with Slip Ward's reroll or with Redline Focus's downgrade — on any given Slip, pick one of the three and use only that one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Roll twice on the Slip table and choose either; doesn't stack with Slip Ward's reroll or Redline Focus's downgrade. Deadhand's Slip table is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
